reuse.why: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend like getUpcomingDates; the daily weekend skip is written inline because the tree has it only embedded in getNextDate.

duplication.why: The 'daily + skipWeekend means drop weekend occurrences' decision repeats the inline rule in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate rather than extracting a shared predicate.

placement.why: The handler sits in server/schedules/app.ts next to getUpcomingDates and is registered in SchedulesHandlers and app.method the same way.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Compact and readable, but untyped parameters, the unexplained padding of 2 days and the O(n^2) indexOf dedupe are rough edges, and the daily rule now lives in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend moves go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no shared daily-skip helper existed to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip check in getDatesInRange (config.skipWeekend && isWeekend && isDaily) is an evident restatement of getNextDate's rule, not disguised.
